---
title: "Page not found"
description: "Find a moved or mistyped StatWiki page by concept name, abbreviation, or live site search."
toc: false
---

No page exists at the requested address. If you followed an old link or typed a short concept URL, open the closest match below or search across every chapter, concept article, laboratory, and practice question.

```{=html}
<div id="nf-requested" class="hatnote" hidden></div>
<div id="nf-direct" class="search-exact" hidden></div>

<form id="nf-search" class="site-search" role="search">
  <label for="nf-search-q">Search StatWiki</label>
  <input id="nf-search-q" type="search" name="q" placeholder="e.g. sd, t test, Bayes theorem, what is a p value, kernel" autocomplete="off">
  <button type="submit">Search</button>
</form>

<p id="nf-note"></p>
<ol id="nf-results"></ol>

<script type="module">
const offsetMeta = document.querySelector('meta[name="quarto:offset"]');
const rawOffset = offsetMeta ? (offsetMeta.getAttribute("content") || "/") : "/";
const rootUrl = rawOffset.startsWith("/")
  ? new URL(rawOffset, location.origin).href
  : new URL(rawOffset, location.href).href;

function toRootHref(relHref) {
  const clean = String(relHref || "").replace(/^(\.\/|\.\.\/|\/)+/, "");
  return new URL(clean, rootUrl).href;
}

function slugFromLocation() {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const explicit = params.get("q") || params.get("query") || "";
  if (explicit.trim()) return { rawPath: explicit.trim(), query: explicit.trim(), stem: "" };
  const pathParam = params.get("path") || location.pathname || "";
  const cleanedPath = decodeURIComponent(pathParam).replace(/\/+$/, "");
  if (!cleanedPath || /\/404(\.html)?$/i.test(cleanedPath) || cleanedPath === "/index.html") {
    return { rawPath: "", query: "", stem: "" };
  }
  const parts = cleanedPath.split("/").filter(Boolean);
  const last = (parts[parts.length - 1] || "").replace(/\.(html|qmd)$/i, "");
  if (!last || last === "404" || last === "index") {
    return { rawPath: cleanedPath, query: "", stem: "" };
  }
  const human = last.replace(/[-_]+/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  return { rawPath: cleanedPath, query: human, stem: last.toLowerCase() };
}

const requestedEl = document.getElementById("nf-requested");
const directEl = document.getElementById("nf-direct");
const form = document.getElementById("nf-search");
const input = document.getElementById("nf-search-q");
const note = document.getElementById("nf-note");
const list = document.getElementById("nf-results");

const initial = slugFromLocation();
if (initial.rawPath && initial.query) {
  requestedEl.textContent = "Requested path: " + initial.rawPath;
  requestedEl.hidden = false;
}
input.value = initial.query;

let searchMod = null;
let cachedDocs = null;
let cachedMeta = null;
let lastQuery = "";

async function ensureLoaded() {
  if (searchMod && cachedDocs) return { mod: searchMod, docs: cachedDocs, meta: cachedMeta };
  const [mod, indexRes, aliasRes] = await Promise.all([
    import(toRootHref("search-rank.js")),
    fetch(toRootHref("search.json")),
    fetch(toRootHref("search-aliases.json")).catch(() => null),
  ]);
  if (!indexRes.ok) throw new Error("search index unavailable");
  searchMod = mod;
  cachedDocs = mod.documentsFromIndex(await indexRes.json());
  cachedMeta = aliasRes && aliasRes.ok ? await aliasRes.json() : null;
  return { mod: searchMod, docs: cachedDocs, meta: cachedMeta };
}

function kindLabel(mod, href) {
  const path = String(href || "").split("#")[0].replace(/^\//, "");
  if (path.startsWith("labs/")) return "Laboratory";
  if (path.startsWith("questions/")) return "Question";
  if (path.startsWith("reference/")) return "Reference";
  const tier = mod.tierOf(href);
  if (tier === 0) return "Article";
  if (tier === 1) return "Chapter";
  if (tier === 3) return "Figure";
  return "Page";
}

function buildSnippet(doc, terms) {
  const text = String(doc.text || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  if (!text) return doc.disambiguation || "";
  const folded = text.toLowerCase();
  let at = -1;
  for (const term of terms) {
    const found = folded.indexOf(term.toLowerCase());
    if (found >= 0 && (at < 0 || found < at)) at = found;
  }
  if (at < 0) return text.slice(0, 180);
  const start = Math.max(0, at - 60);
  return (start ? "…" : "") + text.slice(start, start + 180) + (start + 180 < text.length ? "…" : "");
}

async function runLookup(query, stemHint = "") {
  list.innerHTML = "";
  directEl.hidden = true;
  directEl.textContent = "";
  const q = String(query || "").trim();
  lastQuery = q;
  if (!q) {
    note.textContent = "Enter a statistical concept, distribution, theorem, question, or abbreviation above.";
    return;
  }

  let mod, docs, meta;
  try {
    ({ mod, docs, meta } = await ensureLoaded());
  } catch (_err) {
    note.textContent = "The search index could not be loaded.";
    return;
  }

  const stemKey = stemHint || mod.canonicalSearchKey(q) || mod.slugKey(q);
  const retiredTarget = meta && meta.redirects ? (meta.redirects[stemKey] || meta.redirects[mod.slugKey(q)]) : null;
  const disambig = mod.resolveDisambiguation(q, meta);
  const comparison = !disambig ? mod.resolveComparison(q, meta, docs) : null;
  const exact = !disambig && !comparison ? mod.resolveExactMatch(q, meta, docs) : null;

  if (disambig) {
    const p = document.createElement("p");
    p.className = "search-disambig-title";
    p.textContent = "“" + disambig.term + "” refers to several concepts — choose the intended page:";
    directEl.appendChild(p);
    const ul = document.createElement("ul");
    ul.className = "search-disambig-list";
    for (const opt of disambig.options) {
      const li = document.createElement("li");
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = toRootHref(opt.href);
      a.style.fontWeight = "600";
      a.textContent = opt.label;
      li.appendChild(a);
      if (opt.description) {
        li.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" — " + opt.description));
      }
      ul.appendChild(li);
    }
    directEl.appendChild(ul);
    directEl.hidden = false;
  } else if (comparison) {
    const p = document.createElement("p");
    p.className = "search-disambig-title";
    p.textContent = "Comparing canonical pages:";
    directEl.appendChild(p);
    const ul = document.createElement("ul");
    ul.className = "search-disambig-list";
    for (const target of comparison.targets) {
      const li = document.createElement("li");
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = toRootHref(target.href);
      a.style.fontWeight = "600";
      a.textContent = target.title;
      li.appendChild(a);
      ul.appendChild(li);
    }
    directEl.appendChild(ul);
    directEl.hidden = false;
  } else if (exact || retiredTarget) {
    const targetHref = exact ? toRootHref(exact.href) : toRootHref(retiredTarget);
    const targetTitle = exact ? exact.title : retiredTarget.split("#")[0];
    const p = document.createElement("p");
    p.append("Closest match: ");
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = targetHref;
    a.style.fontWeight = "600";
    a.textContent = targetTitle;
    p.append(a);
    if (exact && exact.alias && exact.alias.toLowerCase() !== exact.title.toLowerCase()) {
      p.append(" (alias: " + exact.alias + ")");
    }
    p.append(" · ");
    const go = document.createElement("a");
    go.href = targetHref;
    go.textContent = "Open page →";
    p.append(go);
    directEl.appendChild(p);
    directEl.hidden = false;
  }

  const found = mod.rankDocuments(docs, q, meta);
  const terms = mod.expandedTerms(q);
  const word = found.length === 1 ? "matching page" : "matching pages";
  note.textContent = found.length
    ? found.length + " " + word + " for “" + q + "”."
    : "No pages matched “" + q + "”. Try a broader term or browse the sections below.";

  for (const doc of found.slice(0, 25)) {
    const item = document.createElement("li");
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = toRootHref(doc.href);
    link.textContent = doc.title || doc.href;
    const kind = document.createElement("span");
    kind.className = "search-kind";
    kind.textContent = kindLabel(mod, doc.href);
    item.append(link, kind);
    if (doc.matchedAlias) {
      const badge = document.createElement("span");
      badge.className = "search-alias";
      badge.textContent = doc.matchedAlias;
      item.append(badge);
    }
    const blurb = document.createElement("p");
    if (doc.section && doc.sectionHref) {
      const secLink = document.createElement("a");
      secLink.href = toRootHref(doc.sectionHref);
      secLink.className = "search-section-link";
      secLink.textContent = "§ " + doc.section;
      blurb.append(secLink, document.createTextNode(" — " + buildSnippet(doc, terms)));
    } else {
      blurb.textContent = buildSnippet(doc, terms);
    }
    item.append(blurb);
    list.appendChild(item);
  }
}

let timer = null;
input.addEventListener("input", () => {
  clearTimeout(timer);
  timer = setTimeout(() => { runLookup(input.value); }, 120);
});

form.addEventListener("submit", async (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  const q = input.value.trim();
  if (q && q === lastQuery && searchMod && cachedDocs) {
    const disambig = searchMod.resolveDisambiguation(q, cachedMeta);
    const comparison = !disambig ? searchMod.resolveComparison(q, cachedMeta, cachedDocs) : null;
    const exact = !disambig && !comparison ? searchMod.resolveExactMatch(q, cachedMeta, cachedDocs) : null;
    if (exact) {
      window.location.href = toRootHref(exact.href);
      return;
    }
  }
  await runLookup(q);
});

runLookup(initial.query, initial.stem);
</script>
```
